title: Public download surface manifest
description: The SURFACE manifest for one release: where the validated bytes are public. Authored by the SURFACE OWNER, not the producer, and deliberately distinct from the producer's signed candidate envelope (release-candidate.json + release-candidate.json.sig), which stays published under its own name with its original signature. This document is the projection: it carries canonical public URLs, surface id and channel context, which the producer cannot know because it does not own the surface. It MAY NOT alter artifact hashes or identities — every asset here must match the admitted candidate exactly — and it is not itself signed, so a consumer's trust in it comes from the applier having bound it to a signature-verified candidate and to the publication evidence before the channel pointer was allowed to advance. Schema written from the format ALREADY PUBLISHED at docsort.io.

published_at.description: Release publication time, carried verbatim from the Release receipt. NOT the candidate's created_at, which records when the candidate was built from its source commit.

candidate.description: Identifies the producer's signed envelope this projection was derived from. manifest_url names release-candidate.json — the envelope — NOT this document.
